title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context. The page belongs to the 'Teichmülleries', the study of low-dimensional Teichmüller (mapping-class) groups by generators and relations. These are the building blocks of the 'Lego' game of the Esquisse d'un programme. The previous page manipulates commutators [σ_∞,ℓ_∞] and cubes (σ_∞(φ)ρ^{-1})^3, apparently in the genus-1 one-puncture setting. This page (dated June 1983) isolates the purely group-theoretic core: a group H generated by two elements ε0, ε1 satisfying the braid relation (*) ε0ε1ε0 = ε1ε0ε1. Then H is a quotient of the Artin braid group B_3.

Definitions.
- σ = ε0ε1ε0. This is the Garside half-twist Δ.
- ρ'0 = σε0 = ε1σ = (ε1ε0)^2 and ρ'1 = σε1 = ε0σ = (ε0ε1)^2.
- ρ0 = σ^{-1}ε0 = ε1σ^{-1} = (ε1ε0)^{-1} and ρ1 = ε0σ^{-1} = σ^{-1}ε1 = (ε0ε1)^{-1}.

Claims on the page.
- (a) Conjugation by σ swaps ε0↔ε1, ρ0↔ρ1 and ρ'0↔ρ'1. Hence σ^2 commutes with the generators, so σ^2 is central and int(σ) = int(σ^{-1}). The NB observes that σε0σ^{-1} = ε1 alone is equivalent to (*), and that it implies the other swap.
- (a') Conjugation by ρ's and ε's:
  - ρ0 and ρ'0 conjugate ε0 to ε1; ρ1 and ρ'1 conjugate ε1 to ε0.
  - ε0 conjugates ρ0 to ρ1 and ρ'0 to ρ'1.
  - ε1 conjugates ρ1 to ρ0 and ρ'1 to ρ'0.
- (b) Expressions of ρ_i and ρ'_i in terms of σ and ε_i.
- (c) ρ0^{-3} = ρ1^{-3} = σ^2 =: ω, which lies in the centre Z(H). This is the classical identity (ε1ε0)^3 = Δ^2.
- (d) ρ'_i = ρ_i^{-2} = ωρ_i, hence int(ρ'_i) = int(ρ_i), and ρ_i = ω^{-1}ρ'_i.

The final NB is an expository decision: leave the ρ'_i out of the main text and give an appendix 'formulaire' for them. The next page carries this out, listing presentations of the same group in the generating pairs (ε0,ε1), (σ,ε0), (σ,ρ0), (σ,ρ'0) and (ε0,ρ0).

Modern reading. With x = σ and y = ρ0^{-1} one recovers the presentation B_3 = ⟨x,y | x^2 = y^3⟩. This is the trefoil group, the central extension of PSL2(Z) = Z/2 * Z/3. B_3/⟨Δ^4⟩ is SL2(Z), the mapping-class group of the once-punctured torus. ω is the central element (Δ^2) whose image in SL2(Z) is −1. The page is a 'formulaire' of the order-2/order-3 generator dictionary used for the genus-1 Lego relations on the surrounding pages.
errors: No mathematical errors. All identities check: e.g. ρ0ε0ρ0^{-1} = ε0^{-1}ε1^{-1}ε0ε1ε0 = ε1, ε0ρ0ε0^{-1} = ε1^{-1}ε0^{-1} = ρ1, (ε1ε0)^3 = σ^2, (ε1ε0)^2 = σε0.
Minor slip (or transcription issue) in (a): the last relation should read σ(ρ'1) = ρ'0.

ideas.what: Braid relation ε0ε1ε0 = ε1ε0ε1 with σ = ε0ε1ε0 swapping the generators; σ^2 central
ideas.modern_name: Garside element Δ of B_3; Δ^2 generates the centre
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses Teichmüller groups of genus 0/1 via such relations, without this formulaire

ideas.what: (ε1ε0)^{-3} = σ^2 central; change of generators to (σ, ρ0) giving x^2 = y^3
ideas.modern_name: Presentation B_3 = ⟨x,y | x^2 = y^3⟩, central extension of PSL2(Z) = Z/2*Z/3; SL2(Z) as a quotient
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme mentions the order-2/order-3 description of the genus-1 Teichmüller group (SL2(Z)) in the Lego context

ideas.what: Table of presentations of the same group in different generating pairs (continued on the next page)
ideas.modern_name: Tietze transformations / equivalent presentations of B_3

deep.surprise_reason: A careful but entirely classical formulaire for B_3 and its quotients (Garside element, centre, x^2 = y^3), serving the genus-1 Teichmüller-Lego computations. Nothing beyond standard facts.
transcription_corrections: In (d), the bracket reads approximately 'donc int(ρ0) = int(ρ'0) = int(ρ0)^{-2}'.
The top-right struck formula seems to be a rewriting of (*) as ε0ε1ε0ε1^{-1}ε0^{-1}ε1^{-1} = 1 (cf. the next page).
